digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md documentation, transition close command
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state that the close precheck requires a MERGED rebar-ticket commit reachable from HEAD, when the implementation (_referencing_commit_exists) scans git log with no ref argument and accepts any commit reachable from current HEAD, merged or not.
The close precheck is conditional (fires only when file_impact is recorded and the completion verification gate is on) but the documentation presents it as unconditional.
The documentation omits the rebar transition --ref flag, which allows closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree to that commit.

The precheck accepts a rebar-ticket trailer for the ticket or any transitive descendant (via list_descendants across epics/stories/tasks/bugs), but documentation does not clarify this subtree matching.
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism, but documentation misleadingly implies the precheck enforces it.
The precheck has multiple exit conditions (require_completion_verification_for_close off, --force-close flag, live duplicate/supersedes replacement link) that the documentation does not enumerate.
